asked.q: Figure-based question: given a sequence of figures, identify the next figure
According to demographic data and census reports in India, which state has the highest old-age dependency ratio? (Answer: Kerala)
Which continent is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to its east and the Pacific Ocean to its west and south? (Answer: South America)
The Vesara style of temple architecture is a hybrid combination of which two architectural styles? (Answer: Nagara and Dravida)
What is the primary objective of ISRO's TDS-01 space mission? (Answer: to demonstrate advanced space technologies including high-thrust electric propulsion)
In Kho-Kho, what is the player called who enters the court to run, defend, and avoid being touched by the chaser? (Answer: runner)
Which scheme was launched to improve and promote sustainable groundwater management in water-stressed areas of India? (Answer: Atal Bhujal Yojana)
By which Constitutional Amendment Act was education transferred from the State List to the Concurrent List? (Answer: 42nd Constitutional Amendment 1976)
